name: FA_MC_CONVERSION_RATES_INT
description: FA_MC_CONVERSION_RATES_INT contains exchange rate information to convert existing asset transaction in the corporate book to the reporting currency when a new subledger level reporting ledger is added to the primary ledger. When you run Phase 1 of the Translate Asset Transactions to Reporting Currency process, the base table FA_MC_CONVERSION_RATES will be populated with all the assets that will be converted. Once Phase 1 is complete you can provide a CONVERSION_BASIS of either R or C to convert each asset. If you provide R as the basis, you will have to provide an exchange rate to use for conversion or use the default rate as defined in the GL conversion options. If you provide a conversion basis of C, you will have to provide the COST of the asset in the reporting currency. The STATUS_CODE should be populated as POST.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE_ID
columns.description: Unique conversion rate identification number.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Name of the asset book in which asset is recorded.

columns.name: SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Unique reporting currency ledger identifier.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code of the reporting ledger.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Unique asset identification number.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: User-defined asset identification number.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Unique lease identification number.

columns.name: LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: User-defined lease number of the lease.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Posting status of the asset transaction. For new records, value will be 'POST' , once processed the value will be updated to 'POSTED' or 'ERROR'.

columns.name: CONVERSION_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Basis for converting transaction amounts from primary ledger currency to the reporting currency.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Total recorded cost of the asset.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Rate used for converting amounts between primary currency and reporting currency.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: User-entered comments of the transaction.

columns.name: ERROR_MSG
columns.description: Error message detailing failure of the posting program.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the loader job that created or last updated the row.
